verdict.rationale: There is no explicit free-tier doc, but the pricing copy promises "10x higher usage limits" on a higher plan, implying a lower-limit base tier. Community users describe trying searches after a "Try it now" sign-up, and one mentions a $20/month paid tier. Sign-up is gated on an institutional or company email, and an independent researcher reported being unable to sign up, so not every researcher can try it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a free tier or trial and its quotas, clarity on how many free searches a researcher gets, and open sign-up without an institutional email.
